name: Scoffing
overview: Scripture reveals that scoffing is a serious offense against God and His people, exemplified by Ishmael's mocking of Isaac (Genesis 21:9) and the scornful rejection of the king's call to repentance by the people of Ephraim and Manasseh (2 Chronicles 30:10). The warnings given through the king's letters urge the Israelites not to be stiffnecked or hardhearted as their ancestors were, but to return humbly to the Lord to avoid His wrath and receive His mercy (2 Chronicles 30:6-9). These passages emphasize the danger of scoffing at God's call and the necessity of repentance to experience His grace.
